name: opencode-chat
description: OpenCode chat as its own sidebar panel — session list, history, and streaming responses backed by a local OpenCode server

opencodeChat.serverUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenCode server to connect to. When autoStartServer is enabled and a workspace folder is open, a per-window server is started on a port derived from the folder path instead.

opencodeChat.autoStartServer.description: Start a per-window OpenCode server automatically when it is not running (loopback URLs only). Each workspace folder gets its own server on a port derived from its path, so multiple VS Code windows can run independent servers.

opencodeChat.workspaceFilter.description: Only show sessions from the current workspace directory.

opencodeChat.completion.enabled.description: Enable inline code completion (ghost text) via a configured model provider.

opencodeChat.completion.provider.description: Completion provider: 'auto' (OpenCode Zen/Go if a key is available, else the first provider authenticated with opencode), 'opencode-zen', 'opencode-go', or any provider id authenticated with opencode: anthropic, deepseek, openai, google, groq, openrouter, xai, mistral, ollama, custom (requires completion.customBaseUrl).

opencodeChat.completion.model.description: Model to use for completions. Empty = provider default. Set to change models.

opencodeChat.completion.apiKey.description: Optional API key for OpenCode Zen/Go. If empty, keys are read from opencode's auth.json. Note: keys stored in settings.json are synced by Settings Sync — prefer VS Code's SecretStorage, or leave this empty to use opencode's auth.json instead.

opencodeChat.completion.baseUrl.description: Override base URL for the completion provider (advanced).

opencodeChat.completion.customBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the 'custom' OpenAI-compatible provider.

opencodeChat.completion.maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate per completion.
